scope: First deterministic whole-body posing workflow for generated Rigify quadrupeds

acceptance.routing: Current gated T0-T4 policy and independent S0-S4 evaluation remain active; recoverable canonical-entrypoint failure records DEGRADED_NATIVE_CONTINUE
acceptance.schema_separation: Quadruped posing remains independent of the humanoid 17-joint solver and learned model
acceptance.controls: Generated torso and four native Rigify IK controls are writable, unlocked and undriven; all four limbs must already be in IK
acceptance.posing: Body and four paw targets solve on transformed generated cat, horse and wolf fixtures within the recorded scale-relative tolerance
acceptance.source_safety: Keep and cancel restore the exact source pose, action curves and IK modes; keep creates one editable pose anchor
acceptance.recovery: A solved preview survives save/reload and can be kept; changed targets, non-IK limbs, locked controls and metarigs fail closed
acceptance.regression: All 50 v0.27.0 source suites plus the new quadruped-pose suite pass with one runtime hash set

qualified: Rigify cat, horse and wolf recognition
Generic pose capture and pose-blending interpolation on generated fixtures
Deterministic body translation and four-paw IK posing on generated Rigify fixtures
Source restoration, anchor capture and save/reload recovery
Explicit UI and runtime boundaries between quadruped and humanoid solvers
not_qualified: Quadruped learned posing or learned motion
Quadruped gait, balance, contact or flight physics
Head orientation, paw orientation, pole direction or detailed spine shaping
Direct metarig, imported or custom quadruped posing

network: No downloads, provider calls or outbound runtime calls are permitted
